turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello! How have you been lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it worth paying more for a laptop with a better webcam?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you're on calls a lot, yes. Most laptop webcams are pretty bad, so a good one really stands out.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do maybe three calls a day for work.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then it's worth it. Look for at least a full HD camera, and good microphones too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I just buy an external webcam instead?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can, and they're often better. But it's one more thing to carry if you work away from your desk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I mostly work from my kitchen table.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then an external webcam on a little stand is a great, cheap fix. You could put the savings toward more memory.
